title: Only 24 and 40 are Δ-primitive among numbers with two prime factors
summary: Among the numbers pˣqʸ, only 24 and 40 are Δ-primitive.
source: V. N. Schvöllner, "The Δ property: a bridge between split graphs and Number Theory", arXiv:2605.25264v1 (24 May 2026). The conjecture is already in the author's 2025 thesis (arXiv:2507.13479).
